capabilities: Theme Web viewer pages with bundled Dark Reader
Match Obsidian theme background, text color and font
Follow Obsidian light/dark switching without reloading
Adjust Dark Reader brightness, contrast and sepia
Reapply or toggle theming via commands
disambiguation: Not the Dark Reader browser extension; it only themes pages inside Obsidian's Web viewer and does not include the extension's per-site rules.
extras: Desktop only (mobile unsupported, relies on the desktop app's <webview>); needs Obsidian 1.8.3 or newer with the Web viewer core plugin on; manual installation only; listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; Dark Reader is bundled so nothing is fetched at run time; uses internal Web viewer APIs that may break on Obsidian updates.
intentEvidence: Dark Reader for Obsidian's built-in Web viewer.
problem: Web pages opened in Obsidian's Web viewer keep their own colors and fonts, so bright white pages clash with dark themes and the vault's appearance.

relations.evidence: The plugin bundles Dark Reader's public API and installs it into each page opened in Obsidian's Web viewer.

requires.name: Obsidian Web viewer core plugin (1.8.3+ desktop)

summary: Dark theme injector that applies Dark Reader to pages opened in Obsidian's built-in Web viewer, using the vault theme's colors and font.
